claims.text: The resort is in Harwich on Pleasant Bay, on Cape Cod.

findings.quote: Wequassett Resort is located in Harwich on Pleasant Bay, one of the most scenic waterfront settings on Cape Cod.

claims.text: Wequassett has welcomed guests for over a century.

findings.quote: For over a century, Wequassett has been more than a resort.
The resort was built in 1925, and is celebrating its 100th anniversary this year.

claims.text: Accommodations include suites, private cottages, villas and homes.

findings.quote: Guests can choose from a range of accommodations, including suites, private cottages, villas, and homes.

claims.text: The villa-style buildings overlook gardens and feature classic New England architecture.

findings.quote: Our villa-style buildings overlook lush gardens and offer a tranquil retreat. Featuring classic New England architecture and elegant interiors

claims.text: Signature Suites are individually styled with coastal inspiration.

findings.quote: Each space in our collection is individually styled with coastal inspiration and thoughtful details

claims.text: The twenty-eight Atlantic restaurant is housed in an 18th-century sea captain's home overlooking Pleasant Bay.

findings.quote: Housed in an 18th-century sea captain’s home overlooking Pleasant Bay

claims.text: The Verandahs has a two-tiered stone terrace for alfresco fine dining, open seasonally.

findings.quote: The Verandahs feature a two-tiered, stone-scape terrace offering alfresco fine-dining in one of New England’s most breathtaking settings. _Open seasonally._

claims.text: A boardwalk of Brazilian woods leads to the pool area's cabanas.

findings.quote: a boardwalk of rich, Brazilian woods leads you to the area’s **Sister Parish** cabanas

claims.text: Guests can watch sunrises over Pleasant Bay from the pool deck.

findings.quote: Enjoy some of the most magnificent sunrises over Pleasant Bay from our pool deck.

claims.text: Activities include paddleboarding, tennis, pickleball and sailing.

findings.quote: Dive into crisp-air coastal living with paddleboarding, tennis, pickleball, sailing, and more.

claims.text: The resort offers seasonal children's programs and accommodations designed for multi-generational stays.

findings.quote: offering seasonal children’s programs, waterfront adventures, pools, and spacious accommodations designed for multi-generational stays.

claims.text: Forbes Travel Guide has awarded the resort Five Stars every year since 2016.

findings.quote: Resort Awarded Five-Stars Every Year Since 2016

claims.text: Private poolside cabanas offer views of Pleasant Bay.

findings.quote: one of our private cabanas. This oversized, poolside retreat offers spectacular views of Pleasant Bay

claims.text: On-the-water options include private whale watching, charters, fishing excursions and private boat rentals on Pleasant Bay.

findings.quote: From private whale watching and scenic charters to fishing excursions and private boat rentals, Wequassett offers unforgettable ways to explore the natural beauty of Pleasant Bay

claims.text: The private home, The Mother Goose House, has three bedrooms, several gathering areas and coastal views.

findings.quote: our private home – The Mother Goose House – is ideal for family stays and extended escapes. With three bedrooms, multiple gathering areas, and coastal views

claims.text: The Cape Cod-style cottages suit families, and many have adjoining rooms and private terraces.

findings.quote: Ideal for families or multi-generational getaways, our charming Cape Cod-style cottages offer space, warmth, and the opportunity to connect. Many feature adjoining rooms and private terraces

claims.text: A heated lap pool reserved for adults sits in a secluded corner of the resort.

findings.quote: Set in a secluded corner of the resort, our adults-only heated lap pool

claims.text: Select dining venues operate seasonally.

findings.quote: Select dining venues operate seasonally, so hours and availability may vary throughout the year.

claims.text: Dogs are welcome, but pets must be under 90 lbs, crated when alone, leashed, and are not allowed at pools or dining areas.

findings.quote: Wequassett welcomes your furry family members with open arms. Dogs enjoy plush beds
Pets must weigh under 90 lbs, be crated when alone, and are welcome in all outdoor spaces except pools and dining areas, but must be on a leash.

claims.text: Reservations are recommended for twenty-eight Atlantic, especially on weekends, holidays and in summer.

findings.quote: Reservations are recommended for twenty-eight Atlantic, particularly during weekends, holidays, and the busy summer season.
